title: Event Production Coordinator
description: An example role supporting the planning and delivery of events, from preparation through on-site coordination.
responsibilities: Coordinate schedules, suppliers, and event logistics.
Support the production team during setup and delivery.
Keep project information and checklists organised.

title: Creative Designer
description: An example creative role developing visual ideas for event environments, branding, and digital communications.
responsibilities: Develop design concepts in response to a project brief.
Prepare artwork for print, presentations, and digital channels.
Collaborate with communications and production teams.

title: Communications Assistant
description: An example opportunity to support content preparation and day-to-day project communications.
responsibilities: Assist with drafting and organising project content.
Support social media and communications planning.
Help document events and maintain project records.
